died.name: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
died.cause: when asked if he was in pain
died.last_words: I would say 'somewhat,' but I cannot utter it.

died.name: Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans
died.cause: remembering his former acclaim on the way to the guillotine

died.name: Gouverneur Morris
died.desc: American statesman and Founding Father of the United States
died.cause: quoting from Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard by Thomas Gray on being told the weather was fine
died.last_words: A beautiful day, yes, but- / 'Who, to dumb forgetfulness a prey, / This pleasing, anxious being e'er resigned; / Left the warm precincts of the cheerful day, / Nor cast one longing, lingering look behind?'

died.name: Princess Charlotte of Wales
died.last_words: You make me drunk. Pray leave me quiet. I feel it affects my head.

died.name: James "Jim" Cullen
died.cause: The 25-year-old Irish man became the only man ever lynched in Mapleton, Maine, after he committed a robbery and beat two deputy sheriffs to death with an axe.

died.name: Arnold Rothstein
died.cause: when asked who had fatally shot him

born.name: Agrippina the Younger
born.last_words: Strike here! Level your rage against the womb which gave birth to such a monster.

born.name: Harlon Block

born.name: Rebecca Schaeffer
